headline: Floods compound fund outflows; listed companies' earnings to decide the fate of the Thai stock market
summary: Foreign investors have sold Thai stocks for eight consecutive trading days, totaling over 34 billion baht. Brokers are awaiting listed companies' earnings to see whether foreign buying returns.
why: The Stock Exchange of Thailand is the main equity market for Thai listed companies, and sustained foreign outflows can pressure index levels and liquidity.
why_moved: Foreign investors have sold Thai equities for eight straight sessions, and floods are compounding the outflows. Investors are waiting on upcoming earnings to judge whether foreign capital will return.
